QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Tinglebrain Potion
QuestInfo.0: Go ask the Sorcerer about retrieving the Amnesiac Temple Keeper's memories.
QuestInfo.1:
You are told that the Tinglebrain Potion should restore lost memories. 
You should pay the 100,000 Mesos for it.
QuestInfo.2: You paid 100,000 Mesos for a batch of Tinglebrain Potion to the Sorcerer. Wait a bit for the Sorcerer to cook up the concoction.

0.0: Ah yes, you're helping the invalid with the mental disorders. I believe a little dose of #bTinglebrain Potion#k might snap him out of his stupor. After all, nothing is impossible for this #p2140002#!
0.1: I must tell you, however, that the potion is not cheap... But I'm sure #b100,000 Mesos#k won't be a problem for someone like you, right? How about that?

yes.0: All right, I'll begin the preparations and the incantations. You bring me #b100,000#k Mesos.

no.0: You don't need it? This potion heals headaches, backaches, toothaches, and arthritis on TOP of recovering memories! You're a fool to pass it up!

yes.0: Stand back and be patient. You will get your #bTinglebrain Potion#k when I have it good and ready!

default.0: Just bring me the #b100,000 Mesos#k for the materials.
